case_number: 2025 INSC 277; SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CIVIL) NO.4293 OF 2024

parties.petitioner: Pappammal (Died) Through Lr R. Krsna Murtii

summary: Substitution of legal representative; impleadment of co-legal heir as defendant; Order XXII Rule 5 CPC; Trial Court's power to determine legal representation; necessity of hearing all parties in dispute over will and property title; challenge to will's validity; non-joinder not fatal; appellate intervention limited; truth-seeking in trial; appeal dismissal upheld.
legal_provisions_cited: Civil Procedure Code, 1908 Order XXII Rule 5
Civil Procedure Code, 1908 Order I Rule 10(2)
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court and Trial Court orders upholding impleadment of respondent no.1 as defendant affirmed.
